description: FontHound: one short line with every prompt, so Claude follows the FontHound skill whenever it is about to choose a font for visible text. It runs no program (echo only), reads nothing, sends nothing and never blocks the prompt.

hooks.command: echo 'FontHound: if this will make you choose a font for visible text (any language or tool), first follow the FontHound skill: call offer_font_picking and ask once, unless fonts are already chosen or the user declined. Otherwise ignore.'
